name: Saturn
description: Browse peer-hosted sites on the Unsync Network directly from Chrome.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://mesh.unsync.uk wss://signal.unsync.uk wss://relay.unsync.uk wss://tracker.webtorrent.dev wss://tracker.openwebtorrent.com
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' blob:; img-src data: blob:; font-src data: blob:; media-src data: blob:; connect-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'
